verdict.rationale: Logseq presents itself as privacy-first, stores data locally, and end-to-end encrypts its Sync service, with no pages public by default. This architecture implies the vendor cannot access notes to train AI models, but the pack contains no explicit statement or policy on AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or terms commitment, a documented opt-out control, and independent verification of how data is handled.
